name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1863: A commit that correctly removed a dead function took six live constants with it, and mini_bounds still names all of them. Every MINI press raised NameError, returned a 500, and the console fetch parsed a non-JSON body and printed that the console is not reachable. Ten versions, every focus, and a toast about the network. Restored, and guarded by a static AST scope walk over every tv module: a name used only inside a function body is resolved when that line runs, so this class cannot be caught at import and has to be checked statically. Also: the TODAY row paired today runs with a lifetime tally count under one word.
